reader.requirement: At --std 85 the compiler must refuse a VALUE clause in a data description entry that carries a REDEFINES clause or in any entry subordinate to one (the entries giving the new description), at level 01 and below, elementary and group, while accepting level-88 condition-name VALUE entries under such entries and leaving the redefined anchor's VALUE legal.

reader.notes: The screen walks the written-REDEFINES ancestor chain of every attached format-1/2 VALUE entry and refuses it; level 88 entries are screened elsewhere and not by this rule, so the condition-name exception holds. The diagnostic text cites §2023:13.18.63.3 SR12 even at --std 85 (cosmetic; the refusal itself is correct).
